technology_name: GI Registered Kannadippaya (Bamboo Mat): From Mats to Wall Hangings
problem_solved: Preservation of traditional tribal heritage crafts, economic marginalization of indigenous artisans, and the loss of eco-friendly consumer alternatives to synthetic lifestyle products.
description: A traditional heritage bamboo mat craft known as Kannadippaya, historically woven by five Scheduled Tribe communities (Oorali, Mannan, Muthuva, Malayan, and Kadar) using fine slivers of thin-walled reed bamboo (Teinostachyum wightii) harvested from the Western Ghats. The hallmark of this craft is its intricate "kannadi" (mirror) square motifs created by interweaving warp and weft patterns into complex layouts with over sixty diagonal and reflective motifs. The mats feature light-reflective qualities and extreme physical flexibility.
applications:
• Premium eco-friendly consumer lifestyle products (sleeping, yoga, and table mats)

• High-end residential and commercial interior design installations or decorative wall hangings

• Sustainable corporate gifting and premium cultural boutique product lines

• Global luxury ethnic handicrafts and eco-tourism retail markets
